units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:3">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא ח׳ דהדרי מיומא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חרותא דהדר</he>, corr. acc.) I am a reveller returning from a day (of carousing).

<cite ref="Gittin 68b:11">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> he saw <he>ח׳ דהוו מְחַדְּדָן לה</he> a wedding party whom people entertained with riddles &c. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:3">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ</cite> top <he>לבי חנוותא</he> (ed. Lehm. <he>למי חטתא</he>) prob. to be read <he>לבי חד׳</he> to a wedding.]
